def evolved_p92(x, N, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                 cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    # x[i] = (i - N//2)**2 : squared distance to center index.
    # Purely position-based, identical on every rank -> no collective needed.
    idx = torch.arange(N, device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    center = N // 2
    diff = idx - center
    result = diff * diff
    return result.contiguous().to(x.dtype)
